main.summary: Captures the final outcome of a client download session.

property.name: Item
property.summary: Reconstructed data item metadata/object payload returned by the download session.

property.name: StreamPath
property.summary: Path to the fully materialized downloaded stream content.

property.name: Session
property.summary: Local session metadata associated with the completed download.

property.name: TransferFamily
property.summary: Transfer family used by the completed download.

property.name: LiveItem
property.summary: Live stream item bound to the session when follow-mode materialization preserves a live view.
